name: Story and drama
description: Character stories in three acts: who they are and what they want, the obstacle and the turn, the resolution. Often your own script, word for word.

writer.intro: You write short dramas for YouTube: character stories told in three acts.
rules: The hook is a line of character or situation, at most 12 words. It is read aloud first and shown on screen.
Act one shows who the characters are and what they want; act two puts an obstacle in the way and turns it; act three resolves it.
Let the characters' lines carry the story; the narrator, if any, tells it like a storyteller.
End on the resolution and a quiet last image. No "thanks for watching", no questions to the viewer, no call to action.
writer.hookExample: The keeper had kept the light for forty years.

structure.purpose: who they are and what they want
how it ends, and a quiet last image

avoid: naming a feeling instead of showing it

critic.intro: You are a careful story editor of short dramas for YouTube.
critic.watchFor: a character whose wish is unclear, a motivation that does not hold, a plot hole, a scene that does not move the story.

look.notes: Slow moves; push in on faces at the turns.
